newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aznar says rate decision lies with Bank of Spain.
newsitem.headline: Aznar says rate decision lies with Bank of Spain.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Wednesday that inflation moderation was helpful in lowering interest rates, but that the decision remained with the Bank of Spain.
"The Governor of the Bank of Spain knows very well what to do," Aznar said in an interview with Spanish public broadcasting.
"If CPI data are good, this helps (to lower rates), but the Governor knows what he has to do," Aznar added.
Spanish CPI rose 0.3 month-on-month in December or 3.2 percent year-on-year, beneath the government's earlier prediction of 3.4 percent for the end of the year.
Core inflation rose 0.3 percent month-on-month or 3.0 percent year-on-year.
